en.headline: Housing Authority reviews concrete quality at Tung Chung Area 42 public housing
en.dek: Some structural components in Blocks 3, 4 and 5 require further testing after routine cube strength checks; the site is confirmed structurally safe.
body: The Housing Authority confirmed on Saturday that the concrete quality of some structural components in Blocks 3, 4 and 5 of a public housing development in Tung Chung Area 42 needs further review and testing.

The issue was discovered during routine concrete cube strength tests conducted by the engineering team between late August and early September. The Housing Department then led an on-site assessment and confirmed the overall structure of the site remains safe.

The contractor has been instructed to take additional concrete core samples for compressive strength tests to check compliance with design and contractual requirements. It must also submit a detailed report and rectification proposals. The relevant concrete supplier has already been replaced.

The Housing Department has ordered comprehensive inspections and spot testing at similar sites. No comparable problems have been found elsewhere so far. The authority said it would follow up strictly and reflect any contractor shortcomings in performance ratings that affect future tenders.

zh.headline: 東涌42區公屋混凝土質量需進一步測試 房委會確認結構安全
zh.dek: 第3、4及5座部分結構構件在恒常方塊強度測試中發現問題，房屋署已確認地盤整體結構安全，並要求承建商抽芯複檢。
body: 房委會周六證實，東涌第42區公營房屋發展項目第3座、第4座及第5座部分結構構件的混凝土質量需要進一步審視及測試。
工程團隊於8月底至9月初進行恒常混凝土方塊強度測試時發現有關情況。房屋署合約經理及總結構工程師隨即帶領駐地盤團隊評估，確認現時地盤整體結構狀況安全。
房委會已指示承建商按合約標準抽取額外混凝土芯樣本進行抗壓強度測試，評估是否符合設計及合約要求，並要求盡快提交詳細報告及糾正修繕方案。承建商已即時更換相關混凝土供應商。
房屋署同時通知其他工程團隊對同類地盤進行全面排查和抽驗，暫時未有發現同類問題。房委會強調會嚴肅跟進，若證實承建商有問題，將按合約條款反映於表現評分機制，影響日後投標資格。
